name: EZ Bar JM Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet planted firmly and hold an EZ bar over your upper chest using a narrow overhand grip.
Bend your elbows and let them travel slightly forward as you lower the bar toward the space above your upper chest.
Stop the bar clear of your face as your forearms approach your upper arms.
Straighten your elbows to press the bar back above your upper chest.
tips: Lower the bar with strict control and stop a few inches above your chin or neck.
Keep your wrists strong and stacked rather than letting the bar roll backward in your hands.
